#!/bin/bash
# usage: shoot.sh <outdir> <id> <url> <light|dark> [expand]
# Captures <id>--desktop.png (1440x900, DPR1) and <id>--iphone.png (Playwright iPhone 15, CSS scale), full page,
# in mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble with host networking, so http://localhost:<port> works.
set -euo pipefail
OUT=$(realpath -m "$1"); case "$OUT" in /data/eval-m27b/*) ;; *) echo "outdir must be under /data/eval-m27b" >&2; exit 2;; esac; ID=$2; URL=$3; SCHEME=${4:-light}; EXP=${5:-}
mkdir -p "$OUT"; J=$(mktemp -p "$OUT" .job-XXXX.json)
if [ -n "$EXP" ]; then X=',"expand":true'; else X=''; fi
echo "[{\"id\":\"$ID\",\"url\":\"$URL\",\"scheme\":\"$SCHEME\",\"noDismiss\":true,\"wait\":2500$X}]" > "$J"
timeout 600 podman run --rm --ipc=host --network=host -v /data/eval-m27b:/data/eval-m27b -w /data/eval-m27b/pw \
  mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble node /data/eval-m27b/bin/cap2.mjs "$J" "$OUT" | tail -1
rm -f "$J"
